topic: find budget-friendly accommodation for a trip
core_question: How do I find affordable, budget-friendly accommodation for a trip? (secondary: How do I get a fresh grease or oil stain out of leather before it sets?)
answer_summary: Search and compare prices across multiple booking platforms (hotel sites, Airbnb, hostels), filter by budget and location, and read recent guest reviews to confirm quality before booking.; after the topic shift: Blot any excess oil immediately, then sprinkle cornstarch (or talcum powder) generously over the stain, let it sit for several hours to overnight so it draws out the oil, and brush the powder away.
